fields.Name: T120 - Integrations Connection Detail View
fields.Description: Opens an Integrations connection detail view once, then exercises its bespoke sub-surfaces (entity-maps detail, entity-map filter, visual field-mapping editor, auto-map schema panel, create-tables panel) in one run, verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T290-T292, T296, T297.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, open its 'Integrations' (Connections) section, and click a connection card body (the icon/name area, not the footer buttons) to open its detail view. Then perform these sub-actions IN ORDER, and as you complete each set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) connection-detail-maps — confirm the view switches from the card grid to a detail screen with a back arrow, the connection name/company header, a 'Sync Schedule' section, and an entity-maps toolbar with a map count (e.g. 'N entity maps · M active') and a filter box (if no connections exist, a clear 'No integrations yet' empty-state is acceptable); (2) entity-map-filter — type text into the 'Filter entity maps...' input that likely matches an entity/external-object name, then type text that matches nothing, and confirm the entity-map list narrows on a match and shows a 'No entity maps match your filter' message on a non-match; (3) visual-field-editor — click an entity-map row to open the visual field-mapping editor and confirm a two-column canvas renders (a 'Source Fields' column, an 'MJ Entity Fields' column, SVG connection lines/badges between them, header stats for mapped/key/required counts, and per-column 'Filter fields' inputs), then type in one field filter box and confirm its field list narrows; (4) auto-map-panel — go back to the entity-maps toolbar and click 'Auto-Map Schema', confirming an inline panel opens with a 'Target Schema' dropdown, Pull/Bidirectional/Push direction buttons, an Auto-Map action, and a close (X) button (do NOT run it); (5) create-tables-panel — click 'Create Tables' in the toolbar and confirm an inline panel opens with a search box, a 'Select All (X of Y)' checkbox, and a checkbox list of source objects (or a clear 'No source objects available' message), and typing in the search narrows the object list (do NOT click Create Tables). A clear empty-state is acceptable anywhere a connection or maps do not exist. Keep going until all sub-actions are done. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

checkpoints.name: connection-detail-maps
checkpoints.instruction: open a connection card into its entity-maps detail view
visualCriteria: Clicking a connection card opens a detail view that replaces the card grid (back arrow + connection header visible) showing a Sync Schedule section and an entity-maps area (list/table or a 'No entity maps configured' state) — or, if no connections exist, a clear empty state is shown

checkpoints.name: entity-map-filter
visualCriteria: A 'Filter entity maps...' input is present in the connection detail toolbar; typing a non-matching term produces a 'No entity maps match your filter' message (or the list visibly narrows for a matching term) — or a valid empty state is shown when the connection has no maps

checkpoints.name: visual-field-editor
checkpoints.instruction: open the SVG visual field-mapping editor for a map
visualCriteria: Clicking an entity-map row opens a field-mapping editor with Source Fields and MJ Entity Fields columns, header stats (mapped/key/required), SVG connection lines/badges between the columns, and a per-column field filter input that narrows its field list when typed into

checkpoints.name: auto-map-panel
checkpoints.instruction: open the Auto-Map Schema panel (do not run it)
visualCriteria: Clicking Auto-Map Schema opens a panel with a Target Schema dropdown, direction (Pull/Bidirectional/Push) buttons, an Auto-Map action, and a close/cancel control — or a valid empty state when no connection is available

checkpoints.name: create-tables-panel
checkpoints.instruction: open the Create Tables panel and search source objects (do not execute)
visualCriteria: Clicking Create Tables opens a panel with a search box and a Select All checkbox above a source-object checkbox list (or a clear 'no source objects' message), and typing in the search narrows the source-object list when objects are present — the panel is only inspected, not executed
